result.rationale: Keep the active platform, but change 'sole owner' to Tiger-controlled, add Fund III AIV U LP and exited sellers, and qualify the mixed ownership model.

identityResolution.management: Mariko McDonagh Meier—CEO; Tim Lukes—President/COO; Andy Cooper—Executive Chair
identityResolution.boundary: No predecessor/name change proven; keep project SPVs/customer microgrids beneath Unison.

owners.organization: Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III AIV U LP
owners.vehicle: Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III AIV U LP

ownershipResolution.structure: Tiger bought Unison from AIF/AIM Universal and Hunt and added growth capital; value and capital split are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
ownershipResolution.control: Tiger's Marc Blair chairs the board. Exact equity, rights, rollover and any continuing minority are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; no co-investor disclosed.

operatingResolution.model: Primary EaaS/ESA: Unison finances, designs, builds, owns, operates and maintains site assets via leases/SPVs, usually for 15-25 years; buyouts are possible.
operatingResolution.otherModels: Also customer-owned EPC, 10-20-year O&M and hybrids; not all systems are Unison-owned.
operatingResolution.scale: At entry: ~30 operating/signed-ESA projects and ~26 MW installed; current scale is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
operatingResolution.technology: CHP, controls, solar, batteries and thermal/chillers; natural gas plus RNG/hydrogen capability.
operatingResolution.markets: Healthcare, data centers, industrial, food/beverage, biofuels/oil and gas, hospitality and logistics; US/North America.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: Reported close/announcement: 2024-06-17; any different legal effective date is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
acquisitionExitCheck.regulatory: FERC named AIM Universal/Hunt before closing and Tiger Fund III AIV U LP after closing.
acquisitionExitCheck.later: No public platform sale, recap, exit or pending transfer found through cutoff; an August 2026 20-year owned-EaaS deal confirms activity.

milestones.event: AIF took control; Hunt became minority owner.
Tiger Fund III announced/reported closing the acquisition and growth investment.
FERC identified Tiger Fund III AIV U LP post-closing.
Unison signed a 20-year Gaylord Pacific EaaS deal it will finance, own and operate.
